backend/main.mo: Main Motoko canister defining user profiles, stats, availability, daily logs, chat messages, and availability query helpers with access control and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report listing feature implementations with associated files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Reference file providing descriptive summaries for major frontend React components, hooks, pages, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables, themes, and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point setting metadata, PWA manifest, icons, splash screens, and mounting the React root.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, start URL, display mode, and theme colors.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with simple styling and a retry button for PWA offline mode.
frontend/public/sw.js: Implements a service worker with precaching, cache cleanup, and network-first fetch handling with offline fallbacks.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing, authentication gating, and initialization logic for user profiles and leaderboard on app load.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access‑denied message for non‑admin users with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Renders the login page with Internet Identity sign‑in and branding.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Shows the app logo image using branding configuration.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Provides a chat UI with message loading, sending, user avatars, and message expansion.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Reusable error message component with optional retry button.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Provides full‑page and inline loading indicators with customizable sizes.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout including header, navigation, footer, and offline banner.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Renders navigation buttons with admin‑only sections based on user role.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageLayou: Provides page wrappers and headers with optional sizing and title icons.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Displays the top bar with logo, user menu, theme toggle, PWA install options, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Profile card UI allowing users to edit their name and upload a profile picture with validation and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the caller’s all‑time leaderboard rank with loading skeleton support.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows the user’s match history with loading, error, and empty‑state handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to enter and save their display name.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: Dialog showing platform‑specific steps to install the PWA to the home screen.
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: Banner that appears when the browser goes offline and hides when back online.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wrapper component applying a faint full‑screen background image behind all content.
Renders a user avatar with initials fallback alongside their display name.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the authenticated user’s profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Hooks to fetch the caller’s user role and admin status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity provider and hook managing authentication state, login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Manages PWA install prompt behavior, tracking availability, platform, standalone mode, and providing a trigger function.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls with React Query hooks for profiles, availability, leaderboard data, and mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Stores and toggles light/dark theme with localStorage and DOM class updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Fetches user display names and avatars for principals, providing directory lookup helpers.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables, plus layout and safe-area rules for light/dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Provides static branding constants including app name and logo details.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for day IDs, date conversions, calendar grids, and date/time formatting.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React root with QueryClient and Internet Identity provider, then renders the app.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Form page allowing users to add or edit availability by selecting date, time, and notes, then saving via mutation.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin panel showing users and their availabilities with options to delete users or specific day entries.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view highlighting days with availability and linking to day details, with chat panel included.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Standalone group chat page displaying the chat panel within a layout.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed availability for a specific day, including user info and option for caller to delete their own availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays leaderboard rankings with options to record or remove daily wins/losses and track rank changes.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile view showing user info, leaderboard rank, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Utilities for converting files to byte arrays and generating initials from names.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Helpers for building, formatting, and parsing time components used in availability inputs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash-based), store/retrieve them in sessionStorage, and manage persisted URL parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, radius, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes project state and tasks focused on global loading/error UI patterns and app-wide spacing and consistency improvements.
